mission_continuity.w15_preexisting_worktree_recovery: The stale local 7f0186e checkout carried changes which were stashed before a safe fast-forward. Tracked changes and all 42 formerly-untracked paths were byte-identical to the pushed 2e54f4f tree; the recovery stash was retained.

finding.scope: Confirmed for merged template-label anchors when a separate horizontal table occupies the same source row; broader applicability depends on workbook layout.
finding.root_cause: When an anchored merged label had no value in its own merged-width-adjacent cell, the preferred-cell strategy scanned as far as seven columns right. Text-valued fields accepted the first non-empty string without a typed-value boundary, crossing into a neighboring table.
finding.current_behavior_before: In the tracked OEOC DDR, K71:L71 is the merged Weather Data label 'Wind Direction'; M71 is blank, while N71:O71 is the first Cement Additives material. The extractor incorrectly accepted 'FLC-DA9 / FLC-DA413' from N71 as safety.wind_direction with status OK and persisted it as canonical data.
finding.expected_behavior: A merged label may inspect only the first source cell after the label's merged extent. If that cell is empty, the field remains unresolved and reviewable; a neighboring table's source value remains assigned to that table only.
finding.implementation: MergeCellAnalyzer.bounds reconstructs merged-range extents. FieldExtractor.extract limits rightward search from a merged label to the first cell after its merged extent, preserving the existing wider search for unmerged anchors.
finding.user_impact: A cement additive could be shown and persisted as a weather-direction observation, contaminating safety/report data and source-to-domain lineage.
